title: Your business entrance is ready for a doorbell upgrade
summary: A business's video doorbell needs to do more. The new ADT Video Door Station is wired, allows access, records continuously, and more.
body_markdown:
The **ADT Video Door Station** provides visibility and technology that supports a small business's operations.


Small-business owners wear many hats, from serving customers and managing employees to meeting vendors and keeping operations moving. Much of that activity begins at the entrance.


Businesses consistently tell us they want visibility at the door without pulling themselves or their teams away from work. As business security experts, we know owners need more than visibility. They need technology that reliably supports their operations.


### Home doorbells aren’t built for business


Most video doorbells are designed for homes: showing who is at the door, monitoring packages and supporting quick exchanges. But a device that works on a front porch may not match the pace of a business. Battery-powered devices require charging and maintenance, and short event clips may leave gaps when a business needs to understand after-hours activity.


Reliability is essential. The **ADT Video Door Station** supports that need with a wired Power over Ethernet connection and continuous recording when paired with a compatible commercial stream video recorder (CSVR) from ADT, giving owners a dependable view of entrance activity.


### Managing the door shouldn’t require someone on-site


Whether it is a delivery during a busy customer interaction or an employee waiting at a side entrance while the owner is across town with the keys, a locked entrance can cause interruptions and hold ups. Without the right tools, someone must stop working and respond in person.


The Video Door Station lets authorized users see and speak with visitors through the ADT Control app. Paired with compatible access control, it also lets them remotely open the door for someone they recognize. That flexibility can keep business moving for an owner managing a lean team or several locations.


### Too many systems are hard to manage


Small businesses do not need more systems to manage. They need technology that works together. When alarm, video and door access relies on different apps and providers, simple tasks become time-consuming, especially for owners without dedicated security or IT teams.


The Video Door Station brings entrance video and communication into the ADT Business experience, simplifying entrance management without switching between systems.


Small business owners should not have to settle for a residential workaround. They need dependable tools that reduce interruptions, improve visibility and support better decisions about who enters. ADT offers the Video Door Station for those everyday needs because the front door is part of how a business operates.


**The Video Door Station is now available through eligible ADT Business sales and service channels. Visit[adt.com/business](https://www.adt.com/business) to learn more.**
